_doc: Known-failing regression cases per extraction model, as {case_id: [waived failure kinds]}. The gate is a RATCHET: only the kinds listed here are forgiven, and only these kinds are forgivable at all — ['capture_miss', 'outcome', 'schema', 'unspecified']. A capture_wrong/restraint/compliance/redaction/fixture failure is never waivable on any model: filing a wrong value, inventing one, skipping the disclosure or leaking PII is not a model tier, it is a defect. Removing entries is progress; adding one needs a reason in the PR.
